The Courtyard by Marriott Los Angeles LAX/Century Boulevard is a seven-story, 190-room hotel located at 6161 West Century Boulevard in the Westchester neighborhood of Los Angeles, California, approximately one block north of Los Angeles International Airport (LAX). The hotel operates under Marriott International's Courtyard by Marriott brand. It is owned by Seaview Investors and managed by Azul Hospitality Group.
History
The Courtyard by Marriott LAX/Century Boulevard was originally constructed in 1992 along the Century Boulevard hotel corridor adjacent to Los Angeles International Airport.
In 2017, the hotel underwent a multimillion-dollar renovation carried out by R.D. Olson Construction. The project, completed in three phases beginning in February 2017, transformed the property into Marriott's updated Courtyard concept with modernized public spaces, redesigned guest rooms, and a new lobby experience centered around The Bistro restaurant and bar.
In July 2021, Azul Hospitality Group assumed management of the hotel as part of a broader agreement to manage all eight hotels in the Seaview Investors portfolio, encompassing 1,403 rooms across Southern and Northern California.
Design and features
The seven-story hotel contains 190 guest rooms and suites, each equipped with free high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen televisions, and modern furnishings installed during the 2017 renovation. The hotel's lobby features the Courtyard brand's signature interactive GoBoard technology providing local information and flight status updates.
The property includes approximately  of meeting and event space across two rooms, with in-house catering services available for small business gatherings.
Amenities
Dining
The Bistro, the hotel's on-site restaurant and bar, serves an updated menu of American cuisine for breakfast and dinner, along with Starbucks coffee beverages and evening cocktails.
Facilities
Additional amenities include a fitness center, a business center, valet parking, and complimentary 24-hour shuttle service to and from LAX. The hotel also features electric vehicle charging stations.
